content.title: “You Christians believe in three gods.”
content.context: A Muslim neighbour raises a concern about the Trinity.
content.question: Which response first clarifies the disagreement?
options: Christians confess one God. Can I explain what we mean by persons and being?
It is exactly like water, ice and steam.
You would understand if you read the Bible.

explanation.text: State the actual Christian claim and invite clarification. An analogy may obscure the doctrine, while a dismissive reply avoids the question. Understanding the claim does not require your neighbour to accept it.

content.prompt: Explain the Christian claim in two sentences, then ask a question that invites a reply.
content.label: The Trinity
